caption: The drawing depicts a single pitcher rendered in pencil on a cream-colored background. The pitcher features a wide, gently flared mouth with a prominent lip, a large rounded body with spiral ribbing, and a curved handle attached at the top and lower sides. The handle has a decorative element resembling a glass loop or bead near its lower attachment point. The base of the pitcher is circular and slightly raised. Shading on the pitcher provides a sense of volume and form. In the upper right corner of the page, there are handwritten notes, reading “Get more form. Check up on drawing.” The rest of the page is blank except for the pitcher and the notes.
title: Blown Glass - Pitcher
